title: Q1 2026 yellow taxis: 11.08M trips and $330.0M billed passenger spend
summary: NYC yellow taxis recorded 11,077,206 trips and $330.03 million in billed passenger spend (SUM of total_amount, as recorded, not inflation-adjusted) in Q1 2026 — the only Q1 in the warehouse. March led on volume and on calendar-normalised daily rate; 85.60% of trips started in Manhattan, weekday evenings were the peak hours, and JFK was the spend-per-trip outlier among the busiest zones.

widgets.title: Q1 2026 trip count by month
widgets.description: Yellow taxi trip counts for January, February, and March 2026. All billed trips are counted, including those with non-positive totals.
widgets.accessibilityText: Bar chart of NYC yellow taxi trip counts in Q1 2026: January 3.72 million, February 3.40 million, March 3.95 million. After calendar normalisation (31/28/31 days), daily volume rose 120,158 to 121,424 to 127,498 trips per day. Grain is one TLC trip; all 11,077,206 Q1 trips are included.

widgets.title: Q1 2026 billed passenger spend by month
widgets.description: Billed passenger spend is SUM(total_amount) in recorded USD by Q1 2026 month, including zeros and negatives, not inflation-adjusted.
widgets.accessibilityText: Bar chart of billed passenger spend (USD, SUM of total_amount) in Q1 2026: January $108.69 million, February $102.38 million, March $118.96 million. Daily spend still rose $3.51M to $3.66M to $3.84M after calendar normalisation. Includes 90,080 non-positive totals (0.81%). Not inflation-adjusted.

widgets.title: Q1 2026 pickups by weekday and hour
widgets.description: Pickup trip counts for Q1 2026 as a weekday-by-hour grid. Hours are 0–23; weekdays follow ISO order Monday through Sunday.
widgets.accessibilityText: Heatmap of all 11,077,206 Q1 2026 yellow taxi pickups by weekday (Monday–Sunday, top to bottom) and hour (0–23). Peaks: Thursday 18:00 (133,182 trips), Friday 18:00 (132,043), Thursday 17:00 (122,154). Quietest: Tuesday 03:00 (3,650). Weekend midnight is stronger than weekdays (Sunday 00:00 = 99,662).

widgets.title: Q1 2026 trip count by pickup borough
widgets.description: All Q1 2026 pickup boroughs ranked by trip count. Tooltips show share of all Q1 trips, billed passenger spend (USD), and average positive total.
widgets.accessibilityText: Horizontal bars of Q1 2026 yellow taxi trips by pickup borough. Manhattan 9.48 million trips (85.60%) and $245.58 million billed spend, lowest typical positive total ($26.23). Queens 998,379 trips (9.01%) and $62.34 million at $65.03 average. Brooklyn 465,247 (4.20%). Remaining boroughs each about 1% or less.

widgets.title: Top 12 Q1 2026 pickup zones by trip count
widgets.description: The 12 busiest pickup zones by Q1 2026 trips. Zone share is of all 11,077,206 Q1 trips, not the top-12 subtotal.
widgets.accessibilityText: Horizontal bars of the 12 busiest Q1 2026 pickup zones by trip count. Leaders: Upper East Side South 479,826 (4.33%), Upper East Side North 449,683 (4.06%), Midtown Center 447,264 (4.04%), JFK Airport 431,039 (3.89%)—only non-Manhattan zone in the top 12, $79.69 average billed total. The 12 zones are 38.4% of all Q1 trips.
